about_short_description.short_description: Serif Health provides healthcare price intelligence and contract management solution.

product.name: Signal
product.description: A SaaS platform to search machine-readable file (MRF) rates, generate market benchmarks, and compare provider reimbursement rates across payers and regions.

product.name: APIs
product.description: Endpoints that provide programmatic access to price transparency data for integration into healthcare platforms and applications.

product.name: Data Delivery
product.description: Custom data extracts delivered in formats like CSV, Parquet, Snowflake, or Databricks for bulk access to price transparency data.

product.name: Signal enhancements and Signal Ask
product.description: A set of new Signal platform capabilities including guided Starter Kits, unified workflows, and the AI-powered Signal Ask copilot for healthcare pricing analysis.

product.name: Network Benchmarking
product.description: A Serif Health module that analyzes negotiated rates and claims data to benchmark and compare healthcare networks for benefits decisions.

product.name: Signal Ask
product.description: An AI application that enables users to query healthcare pricing data using plain language.
